source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.extractionTool: pdftotext (poppler); text reordered by printed page and checked against page images (RapidOCR used only as a cross-check)
source.notes: ISC Class XI school quarterly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Quarterly Examination - 2018-19', 'CHEMISTRY', 'Class : XI', 'Time : 3 Hrs. 15 mints', 'Full Marks : 70'; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 195 = 3 h 15 min as printed. The PDF has a real text layer but is a booklet imposition (two printed pages per PDF page: PDF 1 = pp.8|1, PDF 2 = pp.2|7, PDF 3 = pp.4|5, PDF 4 = pp.6|3), so the text layer is jumbled; text was reordered by printed page and every question checked against page images rendered at higher scale. `page` is the PDF page. Instructions: Question 1 is of 20 marks (a. 4x1 fill in the blanks, b. (4) MCQs with three options, c. match the following — marks not printed, 4 by difference, d. 4x2); Q2–8 carry 2 marks, Q9–15 3 marks, Q16–18 5 marks; marks per question come from these instructions. With one alternative per OR pair the pack adds up to the Full Marks 70. Q12's structural formulae are handwritten on the paper itself (part of the question, not a student's writing) and are not reproduced; Q1 a. iii's bond-line structure is also not reproduced. Chemical subscripts/superscripts come out flat in the text layer and were rebuilt as Unicode from the images (flagged). Questions on s-block elements and hydrogen (Q1 b. ii, Q1 d. i, Q7, Q9, Q10) have no matching chapter in the list (chapter null). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
